So now I'm in the right gray at [21,44]. I need to:
1. Collect orange at [22,49] (in right gray)
2. Cover yellow at [41,48] (in right gray)
The orange at [22,49]-[23,50] is in the right gray. The sky blue at [21,44]-[24,47] doesn't overlap with it.

- DOWN to [25,48]

But I also need to collect the orange at [22,49]. The sky blue at [21,48]-[24,51] would overlap with it.
